**Author:** Peter - Cracking Markets (@SystematicPeter) · posted 2026-09-04 14:33Z · received 2026-09-04T16:32:46Z (WhatsApp via RDP-30, routed by CoS). 1 attached media item (chart photo: the strategy's continuously updated backtest — https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRYSVEoaoAAa53Z.png?name=orig).

## Summary
The author's rationale for publishing strategy research with full rules and code, argued through one piece of evidence: a reader email received a year after he shared the QQQ Z-Score strategy on X.

- **The email:** "Hi Peter, Just wanted to send my thanks to you for the QQQ Z-Score strategy that you shared on X about a year ago. I have actually been using it live since then and it has performed extremely well!"
- Full rules **and code** were shared at the time; the chart shows the strategy's **continuously updated backtest** since.
- The point he draws: the valuable signal is not likes/reposts but that **a trader could understand the logic, test it independently, and put it into live practice** — and sometimes one useful idea improves how someone researches, tests, or trades for years.
- He keeps publishing because he has **benefited from other traders' ideas the same way** — reciprocity, not altruism.

## Why it matters
- This is the **author-side rationale for open research publishing**, the mirror image of the reader-side notes already in the vault: the [[2026-08-29-milk-man-replication-metrics]] node documents *independent replication* as stronger evidence than the originator's own backtest — this tweet is what that replication looks like from the originator's side, and why originators bother.
- The email is a **fourth kind of evidence** in the strategy-evidence hierarchy the vault is accumulating: likes/reposts (weak) → self-backtest → independent replication → **live trading by an independent reader, self-reported one year later**. Self-reported and n=1, but the longest-horizon signal we've captured.
- The QQQ Z-Score strategy itself is new to the vault — first mention. Only surface features known: QQQ instrument, z-score-style statistical/mean-reversion logic, has code, backtest chart attached.
- **Skepticism gates:** the email is quoted, not shown; "performed extremely well" is unquantified; the continuously-updated backtest is author-run (self-backtest tier). No position-sizing, regime, or fee detail. Anon reader, cannot verify.
- **Isolation note (CoS convention):** personal second-brain knowledge capture only; nothing routed to the trading company.
